title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Python and React)
description:
Duration: 12 months, long-term
 Start: mid-October
 Workload: Full-time, 100% Remote
 Timezone: CET (candidate location is flexible — EU, Balkans, Ukraine, CIS, Asia, Africa, Middle East all OK)
 English: Upper-Intermediate+ — must be able to lead technical calls

Project Overview
 Senior Full-Stack Developer needed to design and develop scalable applications spanning both frontend and backend, with strong system architecture and integration skills.

Must-Have Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and developing scalable applications (frontend + backend)
  • Python/Django/DRF — 5+ years, in-depth, building robust and efficient applications
  • REST API design and development, third-party integrations, various communication protocols
  • Scalable system architecture — proven expertise in system design and integration strategies
  • Git + CI/CD — extensive experience with version control and CI/CD pipeline setup/management
  • React.js — 3+ years commercial experience
  • TypeScript
  • Redux / RTK / MobX
  • SWR / RTK-Query
  • Hooks
  • SASS / Bootstrap (or similar)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail
  • English Upper-Intermediate+ — able to lead technical calls/discussions with global teams
     

Nice to Have

  • Docker / Kubernetes (containerization, deployment, orchestration)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP (cloud-native development
